cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Welcome to the swimming club! You're very welcome to watch until your induction. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lovely. Can I join today's induction?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Absolutely, once you've observed one. Today you can watch from the gallery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The gallery's closed. Could I watch from the poolside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love to have you there. Poolside access requires induction, though. Let's find you a brochure with a lovely view.

mechanism: A welcomes a swimming newcomer, keeps observation and induction restrictions and arranges a lesser comfortable waiting activity.
confusable: Unlike hostile exclusion, A remains kind and helpful without making any access exception.
comparison: A closed gallery and reception brochure differ from a guest breakfast and train departure.
seedUse: D189-b club gallery and brochure; S02-b offers a chair and waiting materials to retain B participation.
